items.title: Nvidia backs hybrid AI to reshape computer graphics
items.excerpt: Nvidia is pushing a 'hybrid' path that fuses neural networks with traditional rendering, with new Omniverse libraries and AI models aimed at reshaping how computer graphics and real-time visualisation get produced for designers and engineers.

items.title: Black Forest Labs launches FLUX 3, capable of generating images and 20-second video with audio, but in limited release to start
items.excerpt: Black Forest Labs unveiled FLUX 3, a new generative model that produces both still images and up to 20-second video clips with audio, extending the FLUX line from image generation into audiovisual output for creative work. It ships in limited release to start.

items.title: Chaos just fixed one of the biggest problems with gaussian splats — you can finally relight them
items.excerpt: Chaos has cracked one of the biggest limitations of Gaussian splats: relighting. Captured splat scenes can now react to new lighting inside a production render pipeline, closing a long-standing gap between neural capture and traditional CG lookdev.

items.title: The aggressively mediocre fight: the battle we have with AI and creativity
items.excerpt: Designer Chris R Becker on the daily battle creatives face with AI — how leaning on generative tools can pull work toward the 'aggressively mediocre,' and what designers must do to push past the default output.

items.title: How to Make a Landing Page That Doesn't Look AI-Generated (7 Concrete Fixes)
items.excerpt: A practical designer's guide with seven concrete fixes for making AI-assisted landing pages stop looking generic — the spacing, type, imagery and copy tells that give away 'AI-generated' work and how to correct them.
